image_description: A close-up view of a silver car wheel mounted on a grey vehicle. The wheel features a five-spoke alloy rim design with a central emblem, surrounded by a black rubber tire with visible tread and sidewall texture. The wheel is positioned within the wheel well, showing part of the fender and asphalt ground.

The sidewall lettering is indistinct and blurry, lacking the sharp embossing usually seen on real tires, though not structurally impossible.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the fender; if it is gibberish, it confirms AI generation but may not be a severe structural defect. Verify if the spoke symmetry is mathematically perfect or if there are subtle warping issues in the alloy design.
